description: Semantic / similarity search over a vector collection. The LLM does NOT need to know EMBED() or COSINE_SIMILARITY() SQL — this tool embeds the query, runs ANN/exact search, and returns the top-k matches by similarity.

filter.description: Optional metadata equality predicates, e.g. {"category": "electronics"}. Applied client-side after search; for large collections, prefer pre-filtered queries.

query_text.description: Natural-language query to embed and search with

name: semantic_search
